doc: Structure-tensor coherence: gaussian_filter(patch, 1.0) (default mode reflect, truncate 4.0; axis 0 then axis 1; the output keeps the input dtype), np.gradient (central differences inside, one-sided at the borders), products smoothed by gaussian_filter(sigma), coherence sqrt((jxx - jyy)^2 + 4 jxy^2) / (jxx + jyy) weighted by the trace. The two floors of the function: the per-pixel coherence is disc / max(trace, 1e-12) and the weighted mean is sum(coh * trace) / max(sum(trace), 1e-12). The patch is white noise scaled down to a tiny amplitude (values near 0, so the float64 chain keeps its full relative precision: no offset to absorb the digits). Scale 1e-5: per-pixel trace 4.0e-13..7.9e-13 (under the 1e-12 pixel floor, so every coherence is divided by 1e-12), total trace 1.46e-10 (between 1e-12 and 1e-9: the total floor does not bind, but a floor of 1e-9 would). The result 0.139 is not the coherence of the field (0.244, what a port without the pixel floor returns). Float64 chain with no data-dependent branch: an independent float64 reimplementation (explicit reflect-padded kernel sums) agrees to 2.2e-16, a float64 one-ulp nudge of every texel moves the value by <= 4.4e-16; tolerance 1e-9.
